Outer Planet Brewing

Small batch, European-inspired craft beers from outer space  Capitol Hill, Seattle

Our BeersContact

Seattle born, European inspired, Space obsessed

Outer Planet started in 2014, when avid homebrewers decided to take the next step and open a brewery. We brew small batch craft beers and serve them in our space inspired taproom in the heart of Capitol Hill. We are dedicated to making the best beer possible, and we are committed to our community and neighborhood.

  • Regularly rotating small batches
  • Wide variety of European ales, sour and experimental beers
  • Open 7 days a week
  • Family and dog friendly

Outer Planet Brewing is independently and locally owned and operated. We are a member of the Washington Brewers Guild and the Brewers Association.

Find us

Visit our brewery and taproom on Capitol Hill!

1812 12th Ave - Suite 100
Seattle, WA 98122

206-763-7000

  • We are open 7 days a week, and we are family and dog friendly. Indoor and outdoor (covered and heated) seating is available.
  • We have light snacks available, and you are welcome to bring your own food or order delivery to the taproom.
  • We regularly partner with local food pop-ups and Morfire Restaurant next door.

Opening hours
Monday - Friday: 4pm - 10pm
Saturday - Sunday: 2pm - 10pm
